held: its movement-based list reads three courses at up to 4 units (major 20-33 against 20-27): a reread
held (a person's key): the page's figures (9-10, 3, 6, 3-4) add to 21-23 under 'TOTAL UNITS FOR MAJOR: 22-24' and the record reads 21-24, so neither figures kind's sentence holds
held: its arithmetic reads 'unstated' (0 units per noncredit course, no hours), which the Commons counts passing once posted: no gap

held: titled Instrumental/Vocal Performer but read from the 'Commercial Music: Performance' section on #page=288 (shared with 38169 and 38206); its note says no section carries its title and asks a reviewer to confirm, so its identity is unconfirmed: a page-finding step, never a gap

records.words: The degree's major includes the Certificate of Achievement in Architectural Design (21 units), which itself includes the Skills Certificate in Architectural Design (12 units) plus ARC 201, ARC 202, ARC 261. The Skills Certificate course list falls on the previous page and is not in the text; its 12 units are not represented in any block.

program.section_heading: Architectural Design, Associate in Arts Degree (Academic Plan E002430C)
outcomes: Analyze and discuss effectively the impact of theoretical, social, political, economic and cultural concepts that affect our built environment.
Appraise and compare traditional architectural techniques along with CAD (Computer-Aided Design) design process.
Create complex professional multi-media presentations as a means to communicate design intent.

records.words: The degree's major includes the 'Certificate of Achievement in Architectural Technology . . . 22' as a single line; its courses are printed in the certificate's section, not here, so they are not placed in blocks. Reviewer should check the certificate section for ARC 110, 115, 151, 161, 162, 164 and others.

representation: checks.gaps and checks.confidence added as the load reads the filed score; checks.arithmetic, coverage, invented and the record unchanged
claim_check_reads: Today's capture (sources.json): every course an entry names among the codes it found. The capture keeps no page text, so a note's quoted figures are the reader's words, never re-read here.
follow_verdict: The follow_verdict trigger marks a row checked when its latest verdict is a confirm whose fingerprint matches the record and the machine checks pass. The record is unchanged here, so such a confirm on a row this plan moves to passing would check it at the apply, and the rollback would skip it. The pre-read counts those rows (confirm_matches); the apply aborts, writing nothing, unless the count is 0.
